chunks.title: Conditions and Interventions

chunks.content:
Brief summary: This is a multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled phase Ⅱ study to evaluate the efficacy, safety, pharmacokinetics, and immunogenicity of YN-011 in subjects with overweight (27 kg/m2 ≤ BMI \< 30 kg/m2, with at least one comorbidity) or obesity (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2, with or without comorbidities). The entire study period will consist of a 2-week screening period, a 22-week double-blind treatment period, and a 4-week off-treatment follow-up period
Detailed description: None
